channel.description: New summaries and incidents confirmed by several sources in India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt.

item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Security forces in Manipur seized a Kuki-Zo camp, arrested 17 suspects for impersonating SoO cadres and confiscated a large arms cache while protests erupted over the killing of three Meitei men and police seized 24 firearms. The Manipur chief minister proposed a state-wide peace panel after a query from the prime minister. In Kashmir, the IGP called for action against overground workers and hybrid terrorists and urged police to become more intelligence driven. The BJP rebuked Farooq Abdullah for his remarks on PoK and the VHP joined the criticism. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
